scope: Teaching model; map these obligations to real implementation evidence before deployment

assumptions.claim: BH remains representable whenever alignment executes
assumptions.status: refuted for historical Ariane 501 by S2; conditional in model
assumptions.scope: Every reachable phase and new trajectory
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: New vehicle trajectory, scaling, representation or phase schedule
assumptions.consequence: Navigation loss through uncontained conversion failure

assumptions.claim: An unnecessary alignment function cannot affect flight-critical service
assumptions.falsifier: Overflow in alignment halts both navigation units
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Changed task lifetime or exception handling
assumptions.consequence: Apparently noncritical code becomes transitively critical

assumptions.claim: Adding identical replicas prevents a deterministic software failure
assumptions.status: refuted under shared implementation and trigger
assumptions.scope: Common-mode software rather than iid hardware faults
assumptions.falsifier: One, two and three identical units all halt
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Shared code, input, configuration or recovery dependency
assumptions.consequence: Redundancy provides no protection against this cause

assumptions.claim: A present bus frame is valid navigation output
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Message schema or error semantics change
assumptions.consequence: Failure is scored as success or drives unsafe control

assumptions.claim: A nominal-output SRI simulator preserves the implementation failure modes
assumptions.falsifier: Identical hazardous inputs fail with real logic but pass with stub
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Changed mock, simulator, instrumentation or hardware interface
assumptions.consequence: False assurance from missing failure paths

assumptions.claim: Many passing samples establish safety outside their input support
assumptions.falsifier: A million legacy-like passes coexist with expanded-profile failures
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Changed operating distribution or newly identified variable
assumptions.consequence: Inapplicable confidence bounds are transferred to deployment

assumptions.claim: Detecting a violation automatically produces replayable evidence and an enforced response
assumptions.status: refuted by independent replay-retention and response switches
assumptions.scope: Synthetic response policy; not empirical human behavior
assumptions.falsifier: Disable replay retention or response while preserving detection
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Changed logging, evidence retention, gate wiring or decision ownership
assumptions.consequence: A detected defect does not become a reproducible release blocker

assumptions.claim: Any nonzero detection probability makes a short random budget adequate
assumptions.status: refuted relative to a declared discovery target
assumptions.scope: Specified iid rare-tail distribution and 95% target
assumptions.falsifier: 10 tests miss the target at p=0.0005 while 5990 is the minimal adequate budget
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Changed tail probability, dependence, stopping rule or probability target
assumptions.consequence: A possible detection is misrepresented as a high-probability discovery guarantee
